description: Third directed -1 native tick trial on 30 archived published Golems inputs, exact bundled levels and opt-in Golems mechanics. Twenty-six distinct levels had strict native winning replays and ten-probe scores. Attempt failures remain recorded. These alternatives do not change the default-mechanics ledger, and native wins do not prove full source physics parity.
